adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, new attendees are persisted via `await prisma.booking.update({ ... attendees: { createMany: ... }})` (around lines 92–120) before the external side effect `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` (line ~165). There is no transaction spanning the DB write and the calendar sync, so if `updateCalendarAttendees` throws, the DB insert remains committed while the calendar never updates. On retry, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already present in `booking.attendees` and can produce `uniqueGuests.length === 0`, which triggers `TRPCError({ code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "emails_must_be_unique_valid" })`, making the operation non-idempotent and leaving an inconsistent state.
